misconceptions.description: Believing copying a Blackboard course structure verbatim into ALGET is alignment
misconceptions.trigger: migration reproduces the old structure without mapping activities to objectives
misconceptions.feedback: Build an objective-to-activity table first; moving everything is not the same as aligning anything.

misconceptions.description: Assuming recall multiple-choice items measure analysis, documentation, and decision objectives
misconceptions.trigger: all assessment items test definitions while higher objectives have no aligned activity
misconceptions.feedback: Match each objective to a response format that can show it; recall items cannot measure a design decision.

misconceptions.description: Keeping a single-file dropbox that captures no process for adaptive support to read
misconceptions.trigger: migrated activity stores a finished file but no before/after trace
misconceptions.feedback: Replace the dropbox with an artifact trace so ALGET's adaptive support has process evidence to act on.
